description: joinseq with a LOUDNESS score: each pattern item is a PAIR 'fileno gain', so '1 1.0 2 0.5 1 0.25' plays input1 full, input2 at half, input1 at a quarter - sequencing and dynamics in one pass. Variadic upstream; this entry pins 2 inputs. Duration = sum of item durations minus one splice per seam, verified sample-exact (3 one-second items at 15 ms -> 2.9700 s / 130976 frames) - pattern-data-dependent, so the model is the aux-param pre-flight skip sentinel. Gains verified applied per item (0.25 item peaks at exactly 0.25x the source peak) and gains ABOVE 1 are accepted (3.0 ran clean). Unpaired data refused verbatim: 'Data incorrectly paired in file <name>'. All inputs must share channel count. Deterministic.
musical_use: Phrase-building with built-in dynamics: write crescendi and diminuendi into a cell sequence ('1 0.2 1 0.4 1 0.7 1 1.0' is a four-step swell from one sample), shape call-and-response levels between two sources, or echo-decay a motif ('1 1.0 1 0.5 1 0.25 1 0.125') without a separate envelope pass per cell. Gains over 1 push accents. Same seam arithmetic as joinseq (one splice consumed per join - splice 0 for exact sums; long splices melt cells together). Re-roll the number file to re-compose both order AND dynamics with zero audio re-rendering. For patterns without gains use joinseq.

pattern.description: Text file of PAIRED items: 1-based input-file number followed by a gain value, repeated ('1 1.0 2 0.5 1 0.25'; write with write_data_file()). An odd item count is refused verbatim 'Data incorrectly paired in file <name>'; out-of-range file numbers as in joinseq. Gains above 1.0 accepted (3.0 verified). Resolved against the session's data/ directory.

splice.description: Crossfade at each seam in milliseconds (CDP default 15; enforced 0-5000). Each seam shortens the output by exactly this amount (sample-exact). Breakpoint file refused.

splice_start.description: Also splice (fade) the start of the first item. Content only, never duration.

splice_end.description: Also splice (fade) the end of the last item. Content only, never duration.

examples.description: Three-cell phrase with a decaying dynamic.
examples.expected_use: With '1 1.0 2 0.5 1 0.25': three cells at falling levels (verified 0.25x peak on the last), 15 ms crossfades, duration = sum - 2 splices.

known_issues: Output duration is pattern-file-dependent (verified sample-exact per the seam rule): the duration pre-flight skips; the disk watchdog bounds the run.
Items must be PAIRED (fileno gain): odd counts refused 'Data incorrectly paired in file <name>' (verbatim). File numbers are 1-based.
Gains above 1.0 are accepted without warning (3.0 verified) - watch headroom on hot sources.
All inputs must share channel count; entry pins 2 inputs, binary variadic (execute() for more).
Deterministic (identical decoded shas 1.2 s apart). Same 'sfedit join' usage-line banner quirk as joinseq.
